question: Where and how should the cooling yogic practice be applied?
premises: A yogic practice is to be applied
The location is the support region
The practice has a cooling quality
inference: One should apply the cooling yoga in the location of the support region.
uncertainties: ādhāra skandha saṃsthāne may refer to a specific subtle location
